maddeler.e:
أتقابل (form VI)
# أَتَقَابَلُ (ʔataqābalu) /ʔa.ta.qaː.ba.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَقَابَلَ (taqābala)
# أَتَقَابَلَ (ʔataqābala) /ʔa.ta.qaː.ba.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَقَابَلَ (taqābala)
# أَتَقَابَلْ (ʔataqābal) /ʔa.ta.qaː.bal/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَقَابَلَ (taqābala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
